booth/track.monaco.welcome.heard: Welcome to Monaco. Tight city streets, barriers close by, and very little room for a mistake. You spend the whole lap wishing you had another inch, and when you're stuck behind somebody, it feels even narrower

booth/track.spa.welcome.heard: Welcome to Spa-Francorchamps, over four miles through the Ardennes Forest and one of the great racetracks on the planet. And that climb through Eau Rouge, you feel that one in your stomach. Quite a sight from up here, too

booth/track.suzuka.welcome.heard: Welcome to Suzuka, a figure eight circuit with a wonderful rhythm and very little room to get that rhythm wrong. Those S's will keep you busy. Get a little out of shape through the first one, and you're still sorting it out two corners later

booth/cond.day.clear.heard: Sunshine and blue skies today, and the track temperature is climbing. Hot track eats tires. Look after them early, or you'll be sliding all over the place at the end

booth/track.laguna.welcome.heard: Welcome to Laguna Seca, up in the hills of Monterey, California. Eleven turns and one very famous corner. The Corkscrew. You turn in before you can see much of what's below you. Takes a little getting used to

booth/track.haruna.welcome.heard: Mount Haruna. No grandstands, no pit lane, just a mountain road and a whole lot of hairpins on the way down. And on the way down, it's awful easy to ask too much of the brakes. You want a little patience here, even when that road's tempting you

booth/cond.night.heard: Under the lights tonight, and it's a beautiful sight from up here. I always loved racing at night. Track cools off, the car's got more grip, and everything feels about twice as fast.

booth/cond.dusk.heard: The sun's getting low as we get set to go, and the shadows are stretching across the track. That low sun is tricky. You come over a rise, and it's right in your eyes. Can't see a thing for a second

booth/cond.overcast.heard: Gray skies overhead and cool temperatures this afternoon. Cool track. You gotta work to get heat in the tires. First couple laps, it's like driving on ice skates.

booth/cond.rain.heard: And it is wet out there. Rain coming down and spray everywhere. Oh, I hated this. You can't see the car in front of you. You're aiming at a red light in the spray and hoping

booth/incident.save.heard: Oh, the rear steps out. He's sideways Hang on, hang on And he gathers it up. What a save [laughs] Man alive, I'd have needed a minute after that

booth/pass.aggressive.heard: Oh, he's going for it, way down on the inside. Oh, buddy, he just threw that thing in there. And somehow he makes it stick. [laughs] I don't know how he did it, but I like it

booth/intro.standard.heard: Well, we've got a packed grandstand, a full field, and every one of these drivers thinks they can win this thing. Well, [laughs] I'll tell you what, buddy. They might all think they can win. Most of them are fixing to find out otherwise. [laughs] Well, that's one way to look at it. Aw, come on now. You know I'm right. Let's go racing

booth/finish.close.heard: Here they come, side by side, heading for the checkered flag. Come on, who's it gonna be? At the line, he gets him. Unbelievable. Oh man, that's racing right there

booth/moment.wouldve.heard: Bold move there I would have tried that pass Yes, that's what concerns me Oh, you're not gonna let me have that one, are you?

booth/quiet.mirrors.heard: How much do you think about the car behind when the gap gets that small? More than you ought to. I used to look in that mirror so much, I nearly forgot there was a corner in front of me. Nearly? [laughs] We're gonna leave it at nearly

booth/intro.championship.heard: It all comes down to this, a whole season of racing and one afternoon left to settle it. I've sat in that car on a day like this. You tell yourself it's just another race. It ain't. Your hands know it ain't.

booth/start.approaching.heard: Here they come, lined up two by two, and we're just about ready. Right now, every one of them is staring at the car in front. Nobody's thinking about turn one yet. They will be in about five seconds

booth/start.green.heard: And there's the green flag. We are underway. Here we go

booth/intro.standard.2.heard: Good to be back with you. Plenty to talk about today, and plenty of drivers with something to prove. Something to prove is the most dangerous thing you can bring to a racetrack. Makes you brave, and it makes you dumb, about the same amount. Spoken like a man who brought it a few times. [laughs] Every single week

booth/start.green.2.heard: Green flag. Let's go racing. [laughs] Hang on, everybody

booth/pass.clean.heard: A beautiful run off the corner, and he's through. That's patience right there. He waited for a run he could actually do something with

booth/start.chaos.heard: And they're three wide already heading into turn one. Ain't room for three in there. Somebody's gotta lift, and nobody wants to be first

booth/pass.failed.heard: He had a look there. Couldn't quite get alongside. He just didn't have the run. Wanted that opening a little more than the car did

booth/battle.sidebyside.heard: Side by side down the straight, and neither one's giving an inch. Oh, I love this. Door to door, and both of them know exactly where the other one is. That's trust right there

booth/battle.defense.heard: Covering the inside again, making it awfully hard to find a way by. [laughs] Make 'em go the long way around. I used to do that and make 'em mad doing it. [laughs] I don't doubt that for a second

booth/battle.closing.heard: He's closing that gap in a hurry, and the car ahead knows it. Oh, he knows it. You see a car get bigger in that mirror every lap, it starts to feel like it's sitting in the passenger seat

booth/battle.stuck.heard: He's really having to work that car off the corners, trying to find a way by. Yeah, he's waiting on it to settle down, and every second you wait feels about 10 seconds long when you're chasing somebody. A tough place to be when you can see the car you're trying to catch

booth/incident.offtrack.heard: Oh, he's missed the corner completely. Back on track now. [laughs] Well, that's one way to get a better look at the scenery. Unfortunately, it's cost him a couple of spots

booth/incident.spin.heard: Oh, around he goes. Gets it pointed the right way again. Got in there a little hot and the rear just let go. Once it steps out that far, you're a passenger. Good job keeping it off the wall

booth/incident.crash.relief.heard: And the driver is out of the car. Boy, that's good to see

booth/incident.crash.heard: Hard into the wall. That is a heavy impact It certainly is. Let's hope we see him climb out

booth/finish.finallap.heard: One lap to go. That mirror's getting an awful lot of his attention right now

booth/finish.win.heard: And there's the checkered flag. What a drive [laughs] Oh, that's a good one. That's gonna feel real good for a long time

booth/finish.dominant.heard: A commanding performance. Nobody had an answer today. He made that look easy. Keeping it that tidy all afternoon takes some doing.

booth/finish.upset.heard: Would you believe it? Against all the odds, he's done it. [laughs] I did not have that one on my card this morning. [laughs] Nobody did

booth/finish.reflect.heard: There were plenty of times today when that win looked a long way off. He stayed with it. That's what I love about that drive. He just kept giving himself another chance.

booth/quiet.gap.heard: A little breathing room for the leader now. Little bit. I never trusted breathing room till I could see the checkered flag. You weren't much for relaxing, were you? [laughs] Not while somebody behind me was having a better afternoon

booth/quiet.pitwindow.heard: Pit windows open. Now it gets interesting. In the car, you're just waiting on that call. Every lap feels about a mile longer

booth/quiet.tires.heard: Tires starting to fall away now. You can see the car's moving around a little more. You feel it first on the way in. The front starts pushing, then the back wants to come around on you on the way out.

booth/quiet.early.heard: Long way to go yet. My old crew chief used to say, "You can't win it on the first lap, but you sure can lose it."
